visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person in a nun's habit stands against a yellow and black striped background, speaking towards the camera. Below, four individuals in elaborate Halloween costumes—including a green turtle, Chucky, and a ghost-like figure—sit on chairs, reacting to the nun's speech. The lighting is bright and consistent with a professional studio setting. (2) The nun begins a vocal performance, and the camera cuts between her singing and close-up reactions of the seated characters. Chucky, featuring red hair and facial scars, displays a wide-eyed, expressive look. (3) The nun walks away from the center of the frame, moving towards the background of the studio where lights and tripods are visible. The seated audience follows her with their eyes. (4) The nun returns holding a horizontal bar with two additional puppet nun figures attached. They perform a synchronized dance, moving their legs and bodies in unison to a rhythmic beat. (5) A woman in a tan dress and the other costumed characters stand up and join the nun. They all hold onto the bar or each other, creating a long line that moves energetically across the studio floor. (6) The group concludes the performance by lifting and flipping the central nun puppet. Everyone is laughing and cheering as they bow or break formation, surrounded by studio production gear.
